hook: Over *100* OU women students sat on the road over hostel food
hook_b: Over *100* OU women students sat on the road over hostel food
tldr: Students from OU's MBA and law colleges protested on Monday night on the university main road, alleging worm-infested food was making residents ill.

beats.what: Students brought containers of rice and curry out of the hostel and placed them on the road to show the food.
beats.why: A protester said it is not the first time; students have protested over food quality before.
beats.care: Police said the ACP assured students their concerns would be taken up with university authorities; no one was detained.

event.label: Late-night sit-in on OU main road

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Times of India (Nov 17): Director of Women's Hostels Kalyani Yanapu said other issues need other departments and work is underway.

cards.q: How is the food at your hostel or college canteen?

qs: What would an independent check of hostel kitchens find?
How do students formally complain about hostel food at OU?

facts.t: Police said there was *no* preventive detention of the protesting students.

viz.verdict: Students and hostel management disagree on the problem

steps.e: 100+ students sit on OU main road
ACP assures concerns will be taken up
Hostel director: monthly checks, no serious issue

watch: Whether OU puts in place a written complaint route or new checks for hostel kitchens.
